nodes.text: For a flow of blood from the nostrils.
Christ and John went to the Jordan. Then Christ said:
'Stand, Jordan, until John and I have crossed over you.' As the Jordan
stood then, so you stand, blood of this N. Let this be said three times, and each
time let a knot be made in the person's hair.
